Improve your prostate health and bladder control with this gentle 8-minute chair yoga routine. Designed for men over 40 and 50, these easy seated stretches help release pelvic floor tension, improve circulation, and support overall urinary wellness—all from the comfort of your home.
In this routine, we focus on:
Gentle hip openers to relieve pelvic pressure
Seated twists for spinal mobility and internal health
Practical chair-based movements you can do anywhere
